[SCENE: Location matches @Image1: A roomy formal dining room in the Whitmore penthouse, finished in warm neutral tones with a broad dining table, matching chairs and soft nighttime lighting. The open connection to the kitchen keeps the space visually continuous with the penthouse interior.]
[CAST: SLOANE is @Image2. CLAIRE is @Image3. ETHAN is @Image4. Each named character's face, hair, and clothing match their reference image exactly: do not restyle or re-cast.]
[FRAME 0.0s OPENING POSE & BLOCKING: In the WHITMORE PENTHOUSE dining room at night, Sloane sits in Claire’s usual chair, wearing a pearl necklace and smiling across the table. Ethan sits beside her, pleased with himself. Claire sits opposite them, posture composed, her bare throat visible above her neutral top and her pearl earrings catching candlelight.]

[Elegant but sharp push-in on Sloane in Claire’s chair as she lifts her chin to display the necklace, her eyes fixed on Claire, SLOANE speaking with animated lips:]
SLOANE (matching @Audio1): (sweetly, possessive) "Ethan gave me these pearls."

[Macro glide along the pearls at Sloane’s throat, catching candlelight as they shift with her breath; Claire is a soft blur beyond them, filmed close, while SLOANE's voice carries on off-camera. Nobody on screen speaks:]
SLOANE (off-screen, concluding line, matching @Audio1): (sweetly, needling) "Aren’t they gorgeous?"
[Every mouth on screen stays strictly closed with lips firmly motionless; zero lip movement.]

[Tight close-up on Claire’s bare throat and pearl earrings; she holds still, eyes lowered for a beat before looking back up, CLAIRE speaking with animated lips:]
CLAIRE (matching @Audio2): (softly, restrained) "They were my mother’s."

[Cut to Ethan in a close, slightly low angle; he leans back, smug smile widening as he looks toward Claire, ETHAN speaking with animated lips:]
ETHAN (matching @Audio3): (smugly) "Then she’d be happy someone worthy"

[Over-the-shoulder on Claire, holding her steady expression as Ethan continues off camera, CLAIRE reacting with mouth strictly closed and lips motionless as ETHAN's voice carries on off-camera:]
ETHAN (off-screen, concluding line, matching @Audio3): (smugly, contemptuous) "finally wears them."
[CLAIRE keeps mouth strictly closed with lips firmly motionless; zero lip movement.]

[Snap cut to Sloane resting her fingers lightly on the pearls, then looking at Ethan with a mocking half-smile, SLOANE speaking with animated lips:]
SLOANE (matching @Audio1): (mockingly) "She isn’t even angry, Ethan. How boring."

[Medium close-up on Ethan as he straightens with pride, the candlelight catching his confident grin, ETHAN speaking with animated lips:]
ETHAN (matching @Audio3): (proudly) "The board is thrilled. Next quarter,"

[Cut to Claire’s close-up; she gives him a composed, approving look, her mouth closed as he finishes, CLAIRE reacting with mouth strictly closed and lips motionless as ETHAN's voice carries on off-camera:]
ETHAN (off-screen, concluding line, matching @Audio3): (proudly) "I’m taking Whitmore Tech public."
[CLAIRE keeps mouth strictly closed with lips firmly motionless; zero lip movement.]

[Gentle push-in on Claire as she offers Ethan a warm, careful smile, keeping her gaze on him, CLAIRE speaking with animated lips:]
CLAIRE (matching @Audio2): (warmly, convincingly) "That’s wonderful, darling. You’ve worked so hard."

[One unbroken close-up on Claire; candlelight glints in her eyes as her smile barely changes and her gaze settles on the pearls, lips closed. The camera holds this one framing for the whole of this inner thought, with no cut away until it ends. Mouth strictly closed, lips motionless:]
CLAIRE (V.O. - inner thought in @Audio2's voice): (cool, certain inner thought) "Wear them tonight. They’re mine again by morning."
[CLAIRE keeps mouth strictly closed with lips pressed firmly together and motionless, showing how the thought lands only through eye movements and facial expression; zero lip movement.]

RAPID-FIRE PACING & LIP-SYNC DIRECTIVE: Dialogue plays in continuous, rapid-fire succession with instant syllable handoffs across cuts. ZERO pauses, silent breaks, or audio gaps between dialogue lines. Each line begins the instant the previous line finishes. Actions and camera moves happen concurrently while lines are actively spoken, and a camera cut never interrupts, restarts or repeats a line. Synchronize lip movement exclusively onto the active live speakers on camera (SLOANE, CLAIRE, ETHAN). During all (V.O. - inner thought) lines the camera stays locked on CLAIRE, whose mouth is strictly closed and lips completely stationary, reacting solely through eye movements and facial expression. CRITICAL OFF-SCREEN DIALOGUE & REACTION RULE: When the camera cuts, tracks, or frames a reacting character or prop while dialogue is actively concluding or spoken off-camera (L-cut reaction shots), on-screen characters MUST keep their mouths strictly closed with lips completely motionless. NEVER animate the lips or mouth of any character on screen to another character's voice, and do not alter the speaker's vocal timbre. Non-speaking listeners NEVER mouth off-screen dialogue. Fluid rapid-fire pacing throughout. No background music.
